profiles.C4_target: Default stable one in radius2.5; T1 stable three; cast captures actor identity

profiles.sampling: source ATK at cast, target DEF at explosion; no target-death cancellation; dead source cancels remaining cast

normal_packet.target: one ground player captured at cast; stable runtime ID ordering replaces native postFilter4 priority
